name: Sakuba Yuri
source:
The mother of the Sakiba family. She is the biological mother of Sakura and Kaede, but her husband does not exist at this time.

The mainstay of the cheerful and playful Sakiba family who loves to have fun.
Contrary to Yuri's caressing appearance, her skills in general housework are devastating and she leaves everything to her daughters. Sometimes doing housework causes catastrophe.

She loves her daughters and the main protagonist with all her heart, and wants to engage in skinship all the time. There is also a section in which she happily supports the relationship between her daughters and son.

In fact, she is the queen of succubi who rules the demon world, and her two daughters also have her blood. Like a queen of succubi, she is sexually unbridled and has the strongest sexual skills.

After her daughters awaken to become succubi, she trains the protagonist while helping the two.
